verdict.rationale: Plaid's own docs say Identity Verification integrates directly with Plaid Monitor as an end-to-end verification and KYC solution that checks users against watchlists and PEP lists. That covers the same-vendor part of the story. However, Monitor is a separate companion product, and the evidence does not show screening running inside the same API call or a unified review surface. Missing for 10: adverse-media screening, explicit sanctions-list coverage detail, evidence of a single API and single review surface for screening results, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface

citations.quote: Identity Verification also integrates directly with Monitor for an end-to-end verification and KYC solution, allowing you to check for the presence of a user on watchlists and PEP lists
Monitor also integrates directly with Identity Verification for an end-to-end verification and KYC solution.
